construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Earth directing Water broadly — stability ranging across depth as distributed material
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Horizon: current that finds every sea. Opportunity reaches you through flow, conversations, crossings, currents of information arriving before the news does. Your fortune is distributive: many streams, wide deltas, wealth that moves. Dam a portion. Deltas are rich and hard to hold.
candidates.k2_functional: You move liquidly between chances, in early, out clean, rarely anchored.

k2_domain_readings.Opportunity: Your chances arrive by water: distant markets, moving information, the current nobody else has felt yet. Act while it is early. Your edge is timing, and timing evaporates.
k2_domain_readings.Ventures: Your ventures should float: trade, media, logistics, anything that moves. Portfolios over monuments. Keep each light enough to steer and honest enough to dock anywhere.
k2_domain_readings.Father: The father-thread flows distant or briny: a paternal figure of travel, commerce, or currents that carried him elsewhere. From him, your range. The mooring you may have to build yourself.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the current runs thin and you go looking for where it starts. Your gains come from places nobody else has reached yet.

angles.drive: You see a chance coming before it reaches you. Since an early sight feels like a head start, you see the far chance more clearly than the near one. Those who trust your eye get there before the crowd.
angles.cost_self: Seeing far is the part of you that never rests. You see the distant chance before the one in reach, because distance is what sets you free. The good things close at hand often slip away while you look further out.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you see a new chance coming, you are half gone already. You see what is ahead more than who is beside you, and you hand them what is left. The people at your side get your company with your mind already packed.

angles.drive: You move early, before a chance is sure or anyone asks. You would rather move while a thing is open than stay until it is settled. You are through the door while others are still deciding.
angles.cost_self: Your strongest moment is the start, and the start is also your exit. Moving early feels like freedom, and it puts leaving ahead of collecting. The money from your best ideas often lands in someone else's pocket.
angles.cost_others: Moving early also means moving away from people. You move on at the slow part instead of at the end, and you leave the others the whole finish. Whoever starts with you gets you at your brightest.

angles.drive: You share what comes to you as easily as it came. You would rather share a windfall out than put it away. Around you, a bit of good fortune turns into a party for everyone.
angles.cost_self: Sharing freely is how you stay light. You share the whole windfall instead of keeping any, because holding money feels like holding your breath. A good year leaves you with full memories and an empty account.
angles.cost_others: Whenever luck lands, you share it outward first. You share it all at once rather than spread it out, and every feast you throw comes before a long gap. Life around you swings between plenty and making do.

friction.define: As a friction, your Action moves on quicker than it settles. Each opening pulls you on before the last one pays.

angles.drive: You leave a thing before it has finished with you. Staying feels like being stuck, and leaving a chance half done feels better than seeing it through. Remember that the next place looks better mostly because you have not stayed there.
angles.cost_self: Leaving is how you stay free. You would rather leave a venture clean than stay long enough to be owed by it. You leave most ventures a season before the money comes, and you walk away with none of it.
angles.cost_others: Whenever a venture turns slow, you are the first to leave it. Leaving early costs you less than staying, and it costs the people inside a pair of hands. You hand your share of the finish to whoever stays behind.

angles.drive: You spend a windfall at the speed it arrived. Money that comes fast feels unreal to you, and spending it fast feels more honest than saving it. Whatever comes fast, you spend before it ever becomes yours.
angles.cost_self: Spending fast proves the money was real. You spend the windfall instead of keeping any, because keeping feels like waiting. Having spent the last windfall, you meet the next real opening with nothing to put in.
angles.cost_others: Whenever money arrives fast, you spend it on the people around you. You would rather give everyone a good time today than keep some for the months after. The faster you spend it, the longer you leave home short through the lean months.

angles.drive: You look past whoever is in front of you toward what is next. You look at the next place more than at the person across the table, since distance feels safe. Each time you look past someone, you live a little ahead of your life.
angles.cost_self: Looking past the near keeps hope alive. You would rather look far for who is coming than look at who is here. As long as you look past the near, you go without the closeness right beside you.
angles.cost_others: Sitting with someone, you look past them at what comes next. You give the one beside you part of a look rather than the whole, and save the rest for the distance. You hold back the attention that person came for.

edge.lead: Water runs through your wealth, your family and your social life. It is the chance from far away that still pays off, the home that comes with you to whatever city is next, and the stranger who sits down beside you and leaves a friend.
